metadata.database: Warm primary-key reads cycling over 1,000 seeded rows through GORM with GoForj database defaults and one pooled connection. MySQL and PostgreSQL run in local Docker containers; SQLite is a temporary file using the pure-Go driver. Migration, seeding, startup, and connection warmup are outside the timer. These are GORM operation fixtures, not a complete generated application or production database comparison.

metadata.mail: Client send return for one recipient, text and HTML bodies, and a 4 KiB attachment. SMTP uses local plaintext Mailpit. Provider API drivers use local HTTP acceptance fixtures in separate processes with reused connections, no TLS, and dummy credentials. SES includes SDK signing. Log writes JSON to io.Discard; Fake resets every 128 sends, with reset cost included. No real provider calls or inbox delivery.
